 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a mid-level BI Developer to join our growing BizTech team, working alongside our Senior BI Developer to design, build, and scale our enterprise reporting and analytics ecosystem. In this role, you will collaborate on end-to-end dashboard development and upstream data modeling—transforming raw data in Snowflake before surfacing actionable insights in Amazon QuickSight (Amazon Quick) . As our organization expands BI adoption across the business, you will partner closely with the Senior BI Developer to maintain scalable reporting standards, user governance, and self-service analytics.
 This role requires a structured, logical thinker who can bridge data engineering concepts with intuitive visualization design and communicate effectively across both technical and non-technical audiences. Supporting all departments under BizTech, you will manage reporting initiatives as structured projects, partner directly with cross-functional business stakeholders, maintain system documentation, and participate in occasional cross-training on API-driven workflows and integrations.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Dashboard & Report Development: Partner with the Senior BI Developer to design, build, and maintain intuitive, high-performing dashboards and reports in Amazon QuickSight (Amazon Quick) that translate complex business requirements into actionable insights.
 Data Modeling & Transformation: Write optimized SQL queries and perform upstream data modeling and transformations in Snowflake prior to loading datasets into the BI layer.
 Project & Backlog Management: Manage BI initiatives as structured projects from intake through deployment—scoping deliverables, tracking timelines, prioritizing requests, and maintaining clear ticket hygiene in Jira .
 Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration: Partner with stakeholders across all departments under BizTech to gather requirements, translate business objectives into clear technical specifications, and explain technical concepts, data logic, and trade-offs in plain business terms.
 BI Governance & Scaling: Support the expansion of company-wide BI adoption by helping manage user permissions, custom profiles, and data access guardrails to protect sensitive data sources.
 Documentation & Troubleshooting: Maintain clear, up-to-date technical documentation (e.g., in Confluence) for datasets and dashboards, and proactively resolve data quality or performance issues.
 Requirements 
2–4+ years of hands-on experience as a BI Developer building enterprise dashboards and reports using modern BI platforms (such as Power BI , Tableau , or Amazon QuickSight ).
Strong proficiency in SQL , with proven experience writing complex queries and performing data transformations and data modeling within a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake or equivalent).
Proven experience managing work and tracking deliverables in a ticketing system (specifically Jira ), with the ability to organize tasks, manage timelines, and execute BI requests as structured projects (e.g., using agile methodologies).
Strong stakeholder communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on new BI tools, adapt to different platform capabilities, and work autonomously while collaborating effectively with a senior teammate.
Structured, logical problem-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot data discrepancies and trace end-to-end data flows.
Foundational familiarity with system integrations, REST APIs, and iPaaS/workflow automation concepts, with a willingness to participate in occasional cross-training.
Detail-oriented, resourceful, and proficient in written and spoken English.
 Advantageous Skills 
Hands-on experience with Amazon QuickSight (Amazon Quick) and Snowflake .
Working knowledge of AWS services and ecosystem technologies (e.g., S3, Lambda).
Exposure to iPaaS/automation platforms such as n8n (or similar tools like Workato).
Experience working with data from enterprise SaaS platforms such as Salesforce, Jira, or Planful.
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
